Root cause of the 'Instagram-only drafts' problem: Instagram drafts were created with schedulingType 'notification' (Buffer Reminders), which can only be published from the Buffer mobile app; LinkedIn/Facebook were parked on the Ideas board, not in Drafts. Direct test proved schedulingType 'automatic' + saveToDraft true yields a genuinely inert draft on all three channels. Instagram draft switched to automatic; LinkedIn idea converted to a real Buffer draft. Facebook is no longer staged separately: Agata's Instagram account cross-posts to the Facebook Page.
